intro: Marin Noggenfogger finds the thistleshrub dew terrible to taste, yet decides not to give up on it. You are sent to Sprinkle, a friend of Marin's in Gadgetzan, with the dew in hand.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Blech! This stuff tastes terrible! So much for that idea...
Wait, what's that? Oh, I know, I know, you think I shouldn't give up on this stuff. Well, okay then.
Uhhhh, I have an idea! Brilliant! Take this dew to my friend Sprinkle -- she's an excellent chef. Tell her what we're up to here and that we want to make it go down a little easier.
I mean, if it's going to taste that bad, it at least should have some kick to it... And I'm just not feeling it...

clips.title: Progress
paras: So old Marin's up to it again, eh? What's this concoction made from?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Marin's a good guy, don't get me wrong -- just a little... Eccentric, I'd say.
And of course he needs my help, yet again.
